description: Extract constants, utility functions, and shared types into dedicated modules for better organization and reuse
steps: Create src/constants.ts with: (1) WATCH_STATUSES as a const object mapping status keys to their values ('unwatched', 'watching', 'watched'), (2) STATUS_LABELS record mapping WatchStatus to display labels (same ones currently in ShowCard.tsx), (3) STATUS_CYCLE record mapping WatchStatus to next status (same as ShowCard.tsx), (4) PRIORITY_OPTIONS array of {value, label} objects for the 5 priority levels (currently duplicated in AddShowForm.tsx and ShowCard.tsx), (5) DEFAULT_PLATFORMS array (move from storage.ts), (6) STORAGE_KEY constant (move from storage.ts)
Create src/utils.ts with: (1) generateId() function (move uid() from App.tsx, keep same implementation), (2) formatProgress() function (move from ShowCard.tsx)
Update src/storage.ts to import STORAGE_KEY and DEFAULT_PLATFORMS from src/constants.ts instead of defining them inline

Update src/App.tsx to import generateId from src/utils.ts instead of the inline uid() function. Also fix the double-call of loadPlatforms() - the activeId initializer should derive from the platforms state initializer, not call loadPlatforms() a second time. Refactor to: const [platforms, setPlatforms] = useState<Platform[]>(loadPlatforms); const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string>(() => platforms[0]?.id ?? '') -- but since we cannot access platforms in useState initializer, instead use a single initial value: const initialPlatforms = loadPlatforms(); then use it for both useState calls.
Update src/components/ShowCard.tsx to import STATUS_LABELS, STATUS_CYCLE from src/constants.ts and formatProgress from src/utils.ts instead of defining them locally
Update src/components/AddShowForm.tsx to import PRIORITY_OPTIONS from src/constants.ts and render priority <option> elements by mapping over PRIORITY_OPTIONS instead of hard-coding them
Update src/components/ShowCard.tsx priority <select> to use PRIORITY_OPTIONS from constants instead of hard-coded <option> elements
acceptance_criteria: src/constants.ts exists with all extracted constants
src/utils.ts exists with generateId and formatProgress
No duplicate definitions of STATUS_LABELS, STATUS_CYCLE, or priority option lists across components
storage.ts imports from constants.ts instead of defining KEY and DEFAULTS locally
App.tsx calls loadPlatforms() only once during initialization
All existing imports and exports remain consistent (no broken references)
verification: Run grep to confirm no duplicate STATUS_LABELS/STATUS_CYCLE definitions remain in ShowCard.tsx
Run grep to confirm uid() function no longer exists in App.tsx
Run grep to confirm STORAGE_KEY is imported in storage.ts
Verify all new files have correct TypeScript syntax by reading them
findings: All constants, utils, and shared values extracted successfully. App.tsx initialPlatforms pattern used instead of lazy initializer to avoid double loadPlatforms() call. PRIORITY_OPTIONS labels use em-dash character from original code to maintain backward compatibility with tests. No build/test verification possible due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (no node_modules), verified via grep-based consistency checks. Post-review fix: added shortLabel field to PRIORITY_OPTIONS for compact display in ShowCard, fixed double loadPlatforms() with module-level variable, and added unit tests for utils.ts.
